title: Alexandria/Rhambakia
description: While on the march in 325 BC, Alexander arrived in Rhambakia, the chief village of the Oreitai. He ordered Hesphaistion to remain there and see to establishing a city. The location of this city cannot be determined today.

properties.description: Digitized in QGIS using a raster image of BAtlas Map 6, which was georegistered to original projection by the Ancient World Mapping Center in 2003. Dates after BAtlDir.
